text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Good grief, give me a break...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
The guidance counselor lectured me for 
three whole hours.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
I had a tiny little mishap and 
accidentally broke all the classroom 
windowpanes.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
It was an empty classroom and nobody got 
hurt, so I was really hoping they'd let it 
slide.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Haaah... Even tuning out half of what they 
were saying, that was seriously 
exhausting...
